mina (eng-runtime): quick heads-up — we pushed a canary for soft-evict + regional-fallback with a couple of safety knobs (soft thresholds, exclusion list for embedding-heavy tenants). sharing early metrics and next steps.

arjun (product): love to hear the numbers. any customer-facing impact so far?

li (bench): snapshot (2.5h window):
```
canary_host = c-node-21
requests = 36,240
gen_cost_delta = -14.2%
overall_throughput = +5.8%
lat_p50 = -8ms
lat_p95 = -3ms
embedding_cost_delta = +3.1%
```

mina (eng-runtime): tl;dr: net unit-cost win driven by smaller gen flows and fewer cold-start stalls. embedding-heavy routes saw slightly worse batching due to earlier soft-evict; excluded those from the next ramp.

sam (sre): logs look clean. deploy-bot reports warnings for a handful of kv-evict race conditions, no errors.

deploy-bot: canary/2182739999 -> SUCCESS (11:42 UTC). warnings=9, errors=0.

jen (customer-success): any tenants impacted in canary? We should preemptively flag customers that route large batch embedding jobs.

mina (eng-runtime): no customer impact observed in canary pool; we identified 4 tenant routes that would regress — feature-flagging those out now.

arjun (product): please add a short note to the changelog if this goes to prod. customers ask about perf changes.

li (bench): interestingly, p95 improved for multi-region requests because fallback picks warmed replicas instead of waiting on a slot. That cut several long tails that were skewing averages.

mina (eng-runtime): rollout plan: ramp to 5% prod in 1h, 20% in 3h if gates hold, full roll in 24h. Gates (15m windows):
- error_rate <= 0.15%
- p95 regression <= +15%
- cross-region egress delta <= +2.5%
- embedding-tenant cost delta <= +8%

sam (sre): flagging @oncall: watch cross-region traffic and slot scheduling latency. Pause if persistent egress > +3% for 30m.

kate (ceo): big thanks. can we get a one-slide summary for the weekly leadership sync? highlight cost win and safety knobs.

mina (eng-runtime): yes — will post 1-slide and add 6h/24h follow-ups here. Also adding a short post-implementation note to the runtime runbook about the soft-evict thresholds and exclusion list.

li (bench): I'll attach the perf dashboard and the raw query so folks can reproduce the numbers.

mina (eng-runtime): dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/soft-evict/canary-2182739999
raw query id: q_2182739999_kv_evict

arjun (product): thanks — pinging support and docs to prep a short blurb if numbers hold.

mina (eng-runtime): closing loop: will update with 6h + 24h snapshots and open an incident if anything crosses gates.
